verdicts.reason: A is basically the original shrunk and pushed up. The headline and CTA sit in the top half and leave about 280px of empty orange below, so the layout looks lopsided and top-heavy, and the headline is smaller than it needs to be. B rewraps the headline to four lines at a larger size and moves the CTA to the bottom, so the portrait canvas is used with intent and the hierarchy is clearer. Its only flaws are small: the bottom margin under the CTA (about 50px) is much tighter than the top margin (about 170px), and 'Bubbles,' sits alone on a short first line.
